text.p: VANCOUVER, Jan. 23 /CNW/ - GOLDEN TRUMP RESOURCES LTD. is pleased to announce that, subject to its Board of Directors and regulatory approval, it has entered into an agreement with Harlow Ventures Inc. and Swannell Minerals Corp. to earn up to an 80% interest in 23 exploration concessions ("Permissos de Cateos") totaling 206,382 hectares (509,910 acres) located in the Santa Cruz Province of Argentina. To earn a 60% interest, the Company must make payments totalling U.S. $300,000 over two years, expend U.S. $2,500,000 over three years and issue 800,000 of its shares over three years. The Company has an option to acquire an additional 20% interest by making further payments totaling U.S. $7,000,000. The mineral concessions are subject to a 2% net smelter royalty. The agreement is subject to a 30-day due diligence period.

The Santa Cruz province of Argentina is under-explored. The regional geology is predominantly volcanic in origin. Several new and potentially important gold and silver deposits have just recently been identified.

- The most advanced project in the Santa Cruz province to date is the Cerro Vanguardia deposit owned by Anglo American (see note regarding map), slated to come into production in 1998. The property is reported to host 3.4 million ounces of gold and 35 million ounces of silver.

- Yamana Resources recently released results of a preliminary shallow drilling program on its Martinetas property. Assays included 1.02 g/t gold over 114 meters including 14 meters of 4.87 g/t. Yamana recently entered into an agreement in which Rio Algom will explore Yamana's Santa Cruz properties for a 5O% interest by spending U.S. $20 million by 2001. Yamana has identified 30 gold targets and is planning for a 20,000 meter drill program for 1997.

- La Josefina project is being developed by the government mineral agency Fomicruz S.E. Numerous mineralized zones have been identified with preliminary estimations of at least 200,000 ounces of gold at an early stage of exploration.
- Barrick Gold's Manamtal Espejo property hosts epithermal gold-bearing veins that grade as high as 10 g/t gold.

The topography of the area is rolling hills rising above a generally flat plain. The climate is cool desert with mild summers and moderate snowfall in winter. The claims are accessible by a paved highway and excellent secondary gravel roads from Puerto St. Julian. This acquisition gives Golden Trump Resources Ltd. one of the largest mineral exploration land packages in southern Argentina.
